Strategy: Score is the negative product of the leftover and the leftover minus the item size, which is positive exactly when the leftover lies between zero and one item size, so the rule rewards bins whose leftover stays within one item size. It differs from Best Fit whenever the tightest bin leaves more than one item size spare. It may help by keeping residuals small but nonzero, or fail because the band edges are rigid.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [-(r - item) * (r - 2 * item) for r in bins]
```
